div.head: Af El. 49.10
div.ab: Ic þa Ælfred Westseaxena cyng eallum minum witum þas geowde, ⁊ hy þa cwædon, þæt heom þæt licode eallum wel to healdene.
Ic ða Ælfred Westseaxna cyning eallum minum witum þas geeowde, ⁊ hie ða cwædon, þæt him þæt licode eallum to healdanne.
Ego Ælfredus Westsaxonum rex omnibus sapientibus meis hec ostendi, et dixerunt omnes: ‘Placet ea custodire’.
Ic ða Ælfred Westseaxna cyning eallum minnum witum þas geeowde, ⁊ hie ða cwædon, þæt him þæt licode eallum to healdanne.
I, Alfred, king of the West Saxons, then presented these [rulings] to all my counselors, and they then said, that it pleased them all to hold [them].
I, then, Alfred, King of the West Saxons, have shown these to all my councillors, and they have declared that it met with the approval of all, that they should be observed.
Ich nun, Aelfred, König der Westsachsen, zeigte diese [folgenden Gesetze] allen meinen Witan, und sie erklärten darauf, dass es ihnen allen gefiele, [sie] zu halten.
I, then, Alfred, king of the West Saxons, showed these [following laws] to all my councillors, and they then declared that it pleased them all to keep [them].
